newsitem.title: JAPAN: DKB falls after MOF suspends it from JGB auctions.
newsitem.headline: DKB falls after MOF suspends it from JGB auctions.

text.p: Shares of Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB) fell on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on early Thursday morning after the Ministry of Finance announced on Wednesday that it was suspending the bank from Japanese government bond (JGB) auctions and JGB underwriting.
By 0025 GMT, DKB's shares were down 30 yen at 1,410 yen.
The ministry said on Wednesday it was suspending DKB from JGB auctions and JGB underwriting "for the time being", beginning with the next 10-year JGB auction due later this month.

The ministry also said that if a legal complaint was filed with prosecutors against DKB, the suspension would remain in effect until the ministry implemented subsequent administrative penalties against DKB.
